claims.source_title: Wary of Artemis IV timeline, NASA is changing lunar spacesuit design
claims.supporting_quote: Wary of Artemis IV timeline, NASA is changing lunar spacesuit design

claims.claim: Starship Flight 15 targets no earlier than November 13 with a 75-minute window opening at 4:45 p.m. CT.
claims.episode_span: The mission is targeted no earlier than November 13 from Starbase with a 75-minute window opening at 4:45 p.m. CT.
claims.supporting_quote: Launch is targeted for no earlier than Friday, November 13, from Orbital Launch Pad 2 at Starbase, Texas, in a 75-minute window that opens at 4:45 p.m. CT

claims.claim: Booster 22 and Ship 42 are both Block 3 vehicles assigned to Flight 15.
claims.episode_span: Booster 22 and Ship 42, both Block 3 vehicles, are assigned to the flight.
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX will attempt tower catches of Booster 22 and Ship 42 on Starship Flight 15. Both are Block 3 vehicles.

claims.claim: The Anthropic contract pays $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 with 90-day termination notice for either side.
claims.episode_span: The contract runs through May 2029 at $1.25 billion per month.
claims.source_title: SpaceX’s Anthropic deal has a catch, and Elon Musk just addressed it
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX disclosed in its IPO filings in May that Anthropic would pay $1.25 billion per month for dedicated capacity at its Colossus clusters through May 2029, nearly $45 billion in total, with both companies able to terminate on 90 days notice

claims.claim: SpaceX revenue this quarter is projected to exceed NASA’s $18.8 billion fiscal 2027 budget request.
claims.episode_span: The figure tops the $18.8 billion NASA request.
claims.source_title: Key facts: Revenue tops NASA budget; AI data leases; NASA picks Starship
claims.supporting_quote: Elon Musk said Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX) revenue this quarter would exceed NASA’s $18.8 billion fiscal 2027 budget request.

claims.claim: The Starbase supercompute facility is proposed on 444 acres with up to 35 temporary gas turbines delivering an initial 748 MW.
claims.episode_span: The 444-acre facility near the Port of Brownsville would use up to 35 temporary gas turbines for an initial 748 MW output.
claims.source_title: SpaceX plans $24 billion AI supercomputer and gas plant in Starbase, Texas
claims.supporting_quote: The company has proposed a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on a tract of approximately 444 acres east of Brownsville, near the Port of Brownsville. The estimated initial capital investment is $24 billion.
